name: Azabon
summary: Azabon is a central nervous system stimulant of the sulfonamide class that is also used as a nootropic. It has poor antibacterial potency, as is common in benzenesulfonamides with two substituents on N1.2]nonane, itself prepared by pyrolysis of aliphatic diamine.

uses.text: Azabon is a central nervous system stimulant of the sulfonamide class that is also used as a nootropic.

fact.en: It is a sulfonamide, the same chemical family as the first antibacterial drugs, but it hardly kills bacteria at all. Instead it stimulates the central nervous system.
fact.zh: 它屬於磺醯胺類，與最早的抗菌藥物同屬一個化學家族，但它幾乎沒有殺菌能力，反而會刺激中樞神經系統。
fact.zhHans: 它属于磺酰胺类，与最早的抗菌药物同属一个化学家族，但它几乎没有杀菌能力，反而会刺激中枢神经系统。
